name: Deadly Proficiency, Communal
body:
School divination; Level antipaladin 2, bard 2, cleric/oracle 2, inquisitor 2, lathspell 2, paladin 2, sorcerer/wizard 2

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components S, F (a weapon or shield)
Target creatures touched

DESCRIPTION

This spell functions as deadly proficiency, except you divide the duration among the creatures touched.
